title: Remote device that causes defecation

tellings.quote: I know for example, someone that worked on a on a device that uh could make someone immediately have to defecate uncontrollably.

plain: Someone is said to have worked on a device that could make a person suddenly and uncontrollably need to defecate. A guest named Dave Rossi says he knows this person personally, though he does not name them or say where or when the work was done.
